parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue with SimpleLazyObject in nested subquery annotations by modifying the output_field property in query.py. The change is minimal and focused on resolving the reported bug.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding an additional line of code without clear context. The use of getattr with a default value could be clearer.
